context: A boss mentors a uni intern
purpose: Teach: オピニオン/図解/読み込み/終電/賃料/昇給/良品/単品

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、自分のオピニオン、持つことが大事だ。
lines.en: Ren — having your own opinion matters.
lines.style: Measured, slightly leaning forward. Not quite paternal, but the opening of a door. Eye contact that expects him to step through it. Calm authority.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。図解を使った資料、理解しやすいです。
lines.en: Yes. The diagrams made it really easy to understand.
lines.style: Attentive, nodding slightly. A genuine acknowledgment — not just filling silence. Soft energy, genuinely absorbing what he's saying.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 契約書の読み込み、若手の最初の壁だ。
lines.en: Reading contracts — that's the first wall young people hit.
lines.style: Weighty pause before the dash. Speaking from experience, not lecturing. Tone drops slightly, grounding the observation. A quiet recognition of difficulty.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。終電帰り、まだ慣れません。
lines.en: Yes. The late trains home — I'm still getting used to it.
lines.style: A small, self-aware laugh underneath. Tired admission, not complaint. Pace slows on the trailing thought. Vulnerability that he's checking himself for showing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 家賃、賃料、独立への第一歩だ。
lines.en: Rent, independence — that's your first real step.
lines.style: Slower, intentional. This lands differently. Not just directive — something personal underneath. Eyes steady. The weight of what he's saying matters here.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。昇給を励みに、頑張ります。
lines.en: Yes. I'll keep working hard — raises give me something to aim for.
lines.style: Straightforward, almost steady. A note of determination that isn't forced. Not quite confident, but committed. The kind of quiet resolve that impresses without performing.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.en: Quality first — that's how you sell.
lines.style: Firm, economical. Each word has weight. Not harsh, but no room for negotiation. The clarity of someone who knows the difference between good and expedient.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。単品でも価値あるサービス、目指したいです。
lines.en: Yes. I want to build something where even one piece has real value.
lines.style: Quiet sincerity. Slightly vulnerable in admitting the ambition. Not performing for approval — genuinely reaching for something. Soft close, like he means it.
